General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Glove Box Door metal Striker Plate.
This parts screws to the top of the glove box door opening and secures the door shut when it is closed.
Fits 1985-1988 Models Only (1988.5-1995 does not fit)
Direct Replacement
NOTE: This auction is for the Striker only. The glove box door is not included and is shown for illustration purposes only.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – STRIKER PLATE (for the Glove Box Door Opening)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1988 All Models
